Hardware Lab IMS user-form code
On Windows Excel, import the matching .frm file instead of pasting,
unless the import is blocked. Import steps are in docs/WINDOWS_EXCEL_SETUP.md.

==============================================================================
frmAccount.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

' Controls are created in UserForm_Initialize (see modUi).

Private lblMessage As MSForms.Label
Private txtCurrent As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtNew As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtConfirm As MSForms.TextBox
Private WithEvents btnSave As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnClose As MSForms.CommandButton

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    Dim info As Object
    Dim heading As Object
    UiSizeForm Me, "Hardware Lab IMS - My account", 380, 384
    UiTitle Me, "lblTitle", "My account", 18, 12, 340
    UiHint Me, "lblHint", "Check your details. To change your access code, type the current code and the new code twice, then Save.", 18, 38, 340, 26

    Set info = IMS_GetMyAccount()
    If info Is Nothing Then
        DetailRow "Alias ID", gEmpID, 70
        DetailRow "Name", gEmpName, 88
        DetailRow "Role", gRole, 106
        DetailRow "Mail ID", "", 124
        DetailRow "Lead Admin", "", 142
    Else
        DetailRow "Alias ID", CStr(info("EmpID")), 70
        DetailRow "Name", CStr(info("EmpName")), 88
        DetailRow "Role", CStr(info("Role")), 106
        DetailRow "Mail ID", CStr(info("Email")), 124
        DetailRow "Lead Admin", CStr(info("Lead")), 142
    End If
    UiHint Me, "lblDetailsHint", "A Super Admin changes your role, lead, or mail ID.", 18, 160, 340, 12

    Set heading = UiLabel(Me, "lblCodeHead", "Change my access code", 18, 184, 340, 14)
    heading.Font.Bold = True
    UiLabel Me, "lblCurrent", "Current access code", 18, 202, 340, 12
    Set txtCurrent = UiText(Me, "txtCurrent", 18, 216, 340, 32, True)
    UiLabel Me, "lblNew", "New access code (4 to 32 characters)", 18, 240, 340, 12
    Set txtNew = UiText(Me, "txtNew", 18, 254, 340, 32, True)
    UiLabel Me, "lblConfirm", "Type the new access code again", 18, 278, 340, 12
    Set txtConfirm = UiText(Me, "txtConfirm", 18, 292, 340, 32, True)
    Set btnSave = UiButton(Me, "btnSave", "Save new code", 18, 320, 110)
    btnSave.Default = True
    Set btnClose = UiButton(Me, "btnClose", "Close", 136, 320, 80)
    btnClose.Cancel = True
    Set lblMessage = UiLabel(Me, "lblMessage", "", 18, 346, 340, 26)
    If info Is Nothing Then IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
End Sub

Private Sub btnSave_Click()
    If IMS_ChangeAccessCode(txtCurrent.Text, txtNew.Text, txtConfirm.Text) Then
        txtCurrent.Text = ""
        txtNew.Text = ""
        txtConfirm.Text = ""
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Your access code was changed. Use the new code next time you sign in.", False
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnClose_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub DetailRow(ByVal fieldName As String, ByVal value As String, ByVal topPt As Single)
    Dim c As Object
    Set c = UiLabel(Me, "lblK" & CStr(topPt), fieldName, 18, topPt, 90, 14)
    c.ForeColor = UI_MUTED
    If value = "" Then value = "-"
    Set c = UiLabel(Me, "lblV" & CStr(topPt), value, 110, topPt, 248, 14)
    c.Font.Bold = True
End Sub

==============================================================================
frmAuth.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

' Controls are created in UserForm_Initialize (see modUi).

Private lblMessage As MSForms.Label
Private txtEmpID As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtAccessCode As MSForms.TextBox
Private WithEvents btnLogin As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnRegister As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnFillSuper As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnFillAdmin As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnFillLead As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnFillUser As MSForms.CommandButton

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    UiSizeForm Me, "Hardware Lab IMS - Sign in", 360, 300
    UiTitle Me, "lblTitle", "Hardware Lab IMS", 18, 12, 320
    UiHint Me, "lblHint", "Type your alias ID and lab access code, then press Enter. New here? Choose Create account.", 18, 38, 320, 26
    UiLabel Me, "lblEmpID", "Alias ID", 18, 72, 320, 12
    Set txtEmpID = UiText(Me, "txtEmpID", 18, 86, 320, 32)
    UiLabel Me, "lblCode", "Lab access code", 18, 112, 320, 12
    Set txtAccessCode = UiText(Me, "txtAccessCode", 18, 126, 320, 32, True)
    Set btnLogin = UiButton(Me, "btnLogin", "Sign in", 18, 156, 100)
    btnLogin.Default = True
    Set btnRegister = UiButton(Me, "btnRegister", "Create account", 126, 156, 110)

    UiHint Me, "lblDemo", "Sample accounts for the walkthrough:", 18, 190, 320, 12
    Set btnFillSuper = UiButton(Me, "btnFillSuper", "Super Admin", 18, 204, 76)
    Set btnFillAdmin = UiButton(Me, "btnFillAdmin", "Custodian", 99, 204, 76)
    Set btnFillLead = UiButton(Me, "btnFillLead", "Lead", 180, 204, 76)
    Set btnFillUser = UiButton(Me, "btnFillUser", "Engineer", 261, 204, 77)
    Me.Controls("lblDemo").Visible = IMS_SHOW_DEMO_FILL
    btnFillSuper.Visible = IMS_SHOW_DEMO_FILL
    btnFillAdmin.Visible = IMS_SHOW_DEMO_FILL
    btnFillLead.Visible = IMS_SHOW_DEMO_FILL
    btnFillUser.Visible = IMS_SHOW_DEMO_FILL

    Set lblMessage = UiLabel(Me, "lblMessage", "", 18, 232, 320, 36)
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    On Error Resume Next
    txtEmpID.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub btnLogin_Click()
    If IMS_TryLogin(txtEmpID.Text, txtAccessCode.Text) Then
        Unload Me
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnRegister_Click()
    frmRegister.Show
End Sub

Private Sub btnFillSuper_Click()
    FillSample "SA001", "1001"
End Sub

Private Sub btnFillAdmin_Click()
    FillSample "AD010", "2001"
End Sub

Private Sub btnFillLead_Click()
    FillSample "LD200", "4001"
End Sub

Private Sub btnFillUser_Click()
    FillSample "EN1042", "3001"
End Sub

Private Sub FillSample(ByVal empId As String, ByVal code As String)
    txtEmpID.Text = empId
    txtAccessCode.Text = code
    lblMessage.Caption = ""
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)
    If CloseMode = vbFormControlMenu Then IMS_SignOut
End Sub

==============================================================================
frmDashboard.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

' Controls are created in UserForm_Initialize (see modUi).
' The cards and the attention panel use every asset this role may see.
' The filters and search apply to the asset list only.

Private Const FORM_W As Single = 980
Private Const RIGHT_EDGE As Single = 958

Private mReady As Boolean

Private lblWho As MSForms.Label
Private lblHint As MSForms.Label
Private lblCount As MSForms.Label
Private lblMessage As MSForms.Label
Private lblAttnHead As MSForms.Label
Private lblActHead As MSForms.Label
Private cardTotal As MSForms.Label
Private cardAvailable As MSForms.Label
Private cardAssigned As MSForms.Label
Private cardMaint As MSForms.Label
Private cardAMD As MSForms.Label
Private cardWipro As MSForms.Label
Private lstAttention As MSForms.ListBox
Private lstActivity As MSForms.ListBox
Private lstAssets As MSForms.ListBox
Private WithEvents cboOwnership As MSForms.ComboBox
Private WithEvents cboStatus As MSForms.ComboBox
Private WithEvents cboType As MSForms.ComboBox
Private WithEvents txtSearch As MSForms.TextBox
Private WithEvents btnRefresh As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnInward As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnTransfer As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnUsers As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnAccount As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnBackup As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnSignOut As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnExport As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnExportAudit As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnReset As MSForms.CommandButton

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    Dim widths As Variant
    Dim cardW As Single
    Dim isCustodian As Boolean
    isCustodian = IMS_IsCustodianRole(gRole)
    UiSizeForm Me, "Hardware Lab IMS", FORM_W, 512

    Set lblWho = UiLabel(Me, "lblWho", WhoText(), 18, 10, 440, 16)
    lblWho.Font.Bold = True
    lblWho.Font.Size = 11
    lblWho.ForeColor = UI_TEAL
    lblWho.WordWrap = False
    Set btnInward = UiButton(Me, "btnInward", "Inward", 0, 6, 66)
    Set btnTransfer = UiButton(Me, "btnTransfer", "Transfer", 0, 6, 70)
    Set btnUsers = UiButton(Me, "btnUsers", "Accounts", 0, 6, 70)
    Set btnAccount = UiButton(Me, "btnAccount", "My account", 0, 6, 76)
    Set btnBackup = UiButton(Me, "btnBackup", "Back up now", 0, 6, 84)
    Set btnSignOut = UiButton(Me, "btnSignOut", "Sign out", 0, 6, 66)
    btnInward.Visible = isCustodian
    btnTransfer.Visible = isCustodian
    btnUsers.Visible = IMS_IsSuperRole(gRole)
    btnBackup.Visible = IMS_IsSuperRole(gRole)
    PlaceTopButtons
    Set lblHint = UiHint(Me, "lblHint", HintText(), 18, 30, RIGHT_EDGE - 18, 12)

    cardW = (RIGHT_EDGE - 18 - 5 * 8) / 6
    Set cardTotal = UiCard(Me, "cardTotal", "Total assets", UI_CARD, 18, 46, cardW, 42)
    Set cardAvailable = UiCard(Me, "cardAvailable", "Available in lab", UI_CARD, 18 + 1 * (cardW + 8), 46, cardW, 42)
    Set cardAssigned = UiCard(Me, "cardAssigned", "Assigned to engineers", UI_CARD, 18 + 2 * (cardW + 8), 46, cardW, 42)
    Set cardMaint = UiCard(Me, "cardMaint", "Under maintenance", UI_CARD, 18 + 3 * (cardW + 8), 46, cardW, 42)
    Set cardAMD = UiCard(Me, "cardAMD", "AMD-Specific", UI_AMD, 18 + 4 * (cardW + 8), 46, cardW, 42)
    Set cardWipro = UiCard(Me, "cardWipro", "Wipro-Specific", UI_WIPRO, 18 + 5 * (cardW + 8), 46, cardW, 42)

    Set lblAttnHead = UiLabel(Me, "lblAttnHead", "Needs your attention", 18, 94, 464, 12)
    lblAttnHead.Font.Bold = True
    If isCustodian Then
        Set lstAttention = UiList(Me, "lstAttention", 18, 108, 464, 74, "104 pt;350 pt")
        Set lblActHead = UiLabel(Me, "lblActHead", "Recent activity (last 10 moves)", 494, 94, 464, 12)
        lblActHead.Font.Bold = True
        Set lstActivity = UiList(Me, "lstActivity", 494, 108, 464, 74, "66 pt;86 pt;92 pt;92 pt;40 pt;80 pt")
    Else
        Set lstAttention = UiList(Me, "lstAttention", 18, 108, RIGHT_EDGE - 18, 74, "104 pt;820 pt")
    End If

    UiLabel Me, "lblOwner", "Ownership", 18, 190, 150, 12
    Set cboOwnership = UiCombo(Me, "cboOwnership", 18, 202, 150)
    UiLabel Me, "lblStatusFilter", "Status", 176, 190, 170, 12
    Set cboStatus = UiCombo(Me, "cboStatus", 176, 202, 170)
    UiLabel Me, "lblTypeFilter", "Asset type", 354, 190, 150, 12
    Set cboType = UiCombo(Me, "cboType", 354, 202, 150)
    UiLabel Me, "lblSearch", "Search barcode, serial, model, PO, name, or description, then press Enter", 512, 190, 360, 12
    Set txtSearch = UiText(Me, "txtSearch", 512, 202, 360, 64)
    Set btnRefresh = UiButton(Me, "btnRefresh", "Search", 880, 200, 78)
    IMS_FillCombo cboOwnership, IMS_OwnershipList(), True
    IMS_FillCombo cboStatus, IMS_StatusList(), True
    IMS_FillCombo cboType, IMS_AssetTypeList(), True

    widths = Array(100, 84, 80, 90, 90, 90, 160, 66, 134)
    UiColumnHeads Me, "lblCol", Array("Barcode", "Ownership", "Type", "Model", "Serial", "PO", "Status", "Holder", "Holder name"), widths, 18, 228
    Set lstAssets = UiList(Me, "lstAssets", 18, 242, RIGHT_EDGE - 18, 176, UiWidthsText(widths))

    Set lblCount = UiLabel(Me, "lblCount", "0 assets", 18, 426, 300, 14)
    Set btnExport = UiButton(Me, "btnExport", "Export inventory CSV", 0, 422, 130)
    Set btnExportAudit = UiButton(Me, "btnExportAudit", "Export audit CSV", 0, 422, 116)
    Set btnReset = UiButton(Me, "btnReset", "Reset sample data", 0, 422, 116)
    btnExportAudit.Visible = isCustodian
    btnReset.Visible = IMS_IsSuperRole(gRole)
    PlaceBottomButtons
    Set lblMessage = UiLabel(Me, "lblMessage", "", 18, 450, RIGHT_EDGE - 18, 28)
    mReady = True
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    RefreshAll
End Sub

Private Sub btnRefresh_Click()
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub cboOwnership_Change()
    If mReady Then LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub cboStatus_Change()
    If mReady Then LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub cboType_Change()
    If mReady Then LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub txtSearch_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    If KeyCode = vbKeyReturn Then
        KeyCode = 0
        LoadAssets
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnInward_Click()
    frmInward.Show
    RefreshAll
End Sub

Private Sub btnTransfer_Click()
    frmTransfer.Show
    RefreshAll
End Sub

Private Sub btnUsers_Click()
    frmUserAdmin.Show
    RefreshAll
End Sub

Private Sub btnAccount_Click()
    frmAccount.Show
End Sub

Private Sub btnBackup_Click()
    Dim saved As String
    saved = IMS_BackupNow()
    If saved = "" Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Backup saved: " & saved, False
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnSignOut_Click()
    IMS_SignOut
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub btnReset_Click()
    IMS_ResetBackend
    RefreshAll
End Sub

Private Sub btnExport_Click()
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim path As Variant
    On Error GoTo Fail
    data = CurrentRows()
    path = IMS_SuggestExportPath("LabInventory")
    If VarType(path) = vbBoolean Then Exit Sub
    IMS_WriteCsv CStr(path), IMS_AssetHeaders(), data
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Inventory snapshot written to " & CStr(path), False
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Sub btnExportAudit_Click()
    Dim assets As Variant
    Dim auditRows As Variant
    Dim filtered As Variant
    Dim path As Variant
    Dim wanted As Object
    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim kept As Long
    Dim i As Long
    On Error GoTo Fail
    assets = CurrentRows()
    auditRows = IMS_QueryAudit()
    If gLastError <> "" And IsEmpty(auditRows) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set wanted = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    wanted.CompareMode = 1
    If IsArray(assets) Then
        For r = 1 To UBound(assets, 1)
            wanted(CStr(assets(r, 1))) = True
        Next r
    End If
    If Not IsArray(auditRows) Then
        filtered = Empty
    Else
        kept = 0
        For r = 1 To UBound(auditRows, 1)
            If wanted.Exists(CStr(auditRows(r, 3))) Then kept = kept + 1
        Next r
        If kept = 0 Then
            filtered = Empty
        Else
            ReDim filtered(1 To kept, 1 To 7)
            i = 0
            For r = 1 To UBound(auditRows, 1)
                If wanted.Exists(CStr(auditRows(r, 3))) Then
                    i = i + 1
                    For c = 1 To 7
                        filtered(i, c) = auditRows(r, c)
                    Next c
                End If
            Next r
        End If
    End If
    path = IMS_SuggestExportPath("LabAudit")
    If VarType(path) = vbBoolean Then Exit Sub
    IMS_WriteCsv CStr(path), IMS_AuditHeaders(), filtered
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Audit snapshot for the assets on screen written to " & CStr(path), False
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Sub RefreshAll()
    LoadSummary
    LoadAssets
End Sub

Private Sub LoadSummary()
    Dim everything As Variant
    Dim counts As Object
    On Error GoTo Fail
    everything = IMS_QueryAssets("", "", "", "", "")
    Set counts = IMS_CountAssets(everything)
    cardTotal.Caption = CStr(counts("Total"))
    If counts("Scrapped") > 0 Then
        Me.Controls("cardTotalCap").Caption = "Total assets (" & CStr(counts("Scrapped")) & " scrapped)"
    Else
        Me.Controls("cardTotalCap").Caption = "Total assets"
    End If
    cardAvailable.Caption = CStr(counts("Available"))
    cardAssigned.Caption = CStr(counts("Assigned"))
    cardMaint.Caption = CStr(counts("Maintenance"))
    cardAMD.Caption = CStr(counts("AMD"))
    cardWipro.Caption = CStr(counts("Wipro"))
    LoadAttention everything
    If Not lstActivity Is Nothing Then LoadActivity
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Could not read the summary. " & Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Sub LoadAttention(ByVal everything As Variant)
    Dim pending As Variant
    Dim expiring As Variant
    Dim r As Long
    lstAttention.Clear
    If IMS_IsSuperRole(gRole) Then
        pending = IMS_PendingRequests()
        If IsArray(pending) Then
            For r = 1 To UBound(pending, 1)
                AddAttention CStr(pending(r, 1)), CStr(pending(r, 2)) & " is waiting for approval (asked for " & CStr(pending(r, 3)) & "). Open Accounts to approve or reject."
            Next r
        End If
    End If
    expiring = IMS_ExpiryRows(everything)
    If IsArray(expiring) Then
        For r = 1 To UBound(expiring, 1)
            AddAttention CStr(expiring(r, 1)), CStr(expiring(r, 2)) & "  -  " & CStr(expiring(r, 3)) & "  -  " & CStr(expiring(r, 4))
        Next r
    End If
    If lstAttention.ListCount = 0 Then
        AddAttention "All clear", "Nothing needs your attention right now."
        lblAttnHead.Caption = "Needs your attention"
    Else
        lblAttnHead.Caption = "Needs your attention (" & CStr(lstAttention.ListCount) & ")"
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub AddAttention(ByVal item As String, ByVal detail As String)
    lstAttention.AddItem item
    lstAttention.List(lstAttention.ListCount - 1, 1) = detail
End Sub

Private Sub LoadActivity()
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    lstActivity.Clear
    data = IMS_RecentActivity(10)
    If Not IsArray(data) Then
        lstActivity.AddItem ""
        If gLastError <> "" Then
            lstActivity.List(0, 1) = gLastError
        Else
            lstActivity.List(0, 1) = "No moves recorded yet."
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If
    For r = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        lstActivity.AddItem CStr(data(r, 1))
        For c = 2 To 6
            lstActivity.List(lstActivity.ListCount - 1, c - 1) = CStr(data(r, c))
        Next c
    Next r
End Sub

Private Sub LoadAssets()
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim r As Long
    On Error GoTo Fail
    data = CurrentRows()
    lstAssets.Clear
    If Not IsArray(data) Then
        lblCount.Caption = "0 assets match this view"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    For r = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        lstAssets.AddItem CStr(data(r, 1))
        lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, 1) = CStr(data(r, 2))
        lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, 2) = CStr(data(r, 3))
        lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, 3) = CStr(data(r, 4))
        lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, 4) = CStr(data(r, 10))
        lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, 5) = CStr(data(r, 5))
        lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, 6) = CStr(data(r, 6))
        lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, 7) = CStr(data(r, 7))
        lstAssets.List(lstAssets.ListCount - 1, 8) = CStr(data(r, 8))
    Next r
    lblCount.Caption = CStr(UBound(data, 1)) & " assets match this view"
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    lblCount.Caption = "0 assets match this view"
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Function CurrentRows() As Variant
    CurrentRows = IMS_QueryAssets(cboOwnership.Text, cboStatus.Text, cboType.Text, txtSearch.Text, "")
End Function

Private Function WhoText() As String
    Select Case gRole
        Case "User": WhoText = gEmpName & "  (" & gEmpID & ")  -  Engineer view: your assigned hardware"
        Case "Lead Admin": WhoText = gEmpName & "  (" & gEmpID & ")  -  Lead view: your team's hardware"
        Case "Admin": WhoText = gEmpName & "  (" & gEmpID & ")  -  Inventory custodian"
        Case Else: WhoText = gEmpName & "  (" & gEmpID & ")  -  " & gRole
    End Select
End Function

Private Function HintText() As String
    Select Case gRole
        Case "Super Admin"
            HintText = "Approve waiting requests in Accounts. Inward adds hardware, Transfer hands it out or takes it back. Back up now copies the database to the backup folder."
        Case "Admin"
            HintText = "Inward adds new hardware. Transfer hands it out or takes it back. Search finds any barcode, serial, model, PO, or person."
        Case "Lead Admin"
            HintText = "You see hardware held by you and your team. Search, filter, or export the list. The inventory custodian moves hardware."
        Case Else
            HintText = "You see hardware assigned to you. To return or swap a board, contact the inventory custodian."
    End Select
End Function

' Lines up the visible top buttons from the right edge, so hidden ones leave no gap.
Private Sub PlaceTopButtons()
    Dim order As Variant
    Dim i As Long
    Dim x As Single
    order = Array(btnSignOut, btnAccount, btnBackup, btnUsers, btnTransfer, btnInward)
    x = RIGHT_EDGE
    For i = LBound(order) To UBound(order)
        If order(i).Visible Then
            x = x - order(i).Width
            order(i).Left = x
            x = x - 6
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub PlaceBottomButtons()
    Dim order As Variant
    Dim i As Long
    Dim x As Single
    order = Array(btnReset, btnExportAudit, btnExport)
    x = RIGHT_EDGE
    For i = LBound(order) To UBound(order)
        If order(i).Visible Then
            x = x - order(i).Width
            order(i).Left = x
            x = x - 6
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)
    If CloseMode = vbFormControlMenu Then IMS_SignOut
End Sub

==============================================================================
frmInward.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

' Controls are created in UserForm_Initialize (see modUi).
' No button is the Default button: the scanner sends Enter after each barcode.

Private mExisting As Boolean
Private mBlocked As Boolean

Private lblMessage As MSForms.Label
Private WithEvents txtBarcode As MSForms.TextBox
Private optAMD As MSForms.OptionButton
Private optWipro As MSForms.OptionButton
Private cboAssetType As MSForms.ComboBox
Private txtPONumber As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtManufacturer As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtMfsSerialNo As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtMake As MSForms.TextBox
Private WithEvents txtModel As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtCapacityRev As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtDescription As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtArrivalDate As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtExpiryDate As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtInitialAssignee As MSForms.TextBox
Private WithEvents btnSave As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnClear As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnClose As MSForms.CommandButton

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    If Not IMS_IsCustodianRole(gRole) Then
        mBlocked = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    UiSizeForm Me, "Hardware Lab IMS - Inward", 700, 384
    UiTitle Me, "lblTitle", "Inward material", 18, 12, 660
    UiHint Me, "lblHint", "Scan the barcode and let the scanner press Enter. A known board fills in its details. Fields marked * are required.", 18, 38, 660, 26

    UiLabel Me, "lblBarcode", "Barcode / asset tag *", 18, 70, 320, 12
    Set txtBarcode = UiText(Me, "txtBarcode", 18, 84, 320, 64)
    UiLabel Me, "lblOwner", "Ownership *", 18, 108, 320, 12
    Set optAMD = UiOption(Me, "optAMD", "AMD-Specific", "Ownership", 18, 122, 130)
    Set optWipro = UiOption(Me, "optWipro", "Wipro-Specific", "Ownership", 160, 122, 140)
    UiLabel Me, "lblAssetType", "Asset type *", 18, 146, 320, 12
    Set cboAssetType = UiCombo(Me, "cboAssetType", 18, 160, 320)
    IMS_FillCombo cboAssetType, IMS_AssetTypeList(), False
    UiLabel Me, "lblPO", "Purchase order *", 18, 184, 320, 12
    Set txtPONumber = UiText(Me, "txtPONumber", 18, 198, 320, 64)
    UiLabel Me, "lblManufacturer", "Manufacturer", 18, 222, 155, 12
    Set txtManufacturer = UiText(Me, "txtManufacturer", 18, 236, 155, 120)
    UiLabel Me, "lblMfs", "Manufacturer serial", 183, 222, 155, 12
    Set txtMfsSerialNo = UiText(Me, "txtMfsSerialNo", 183, 236, 155, 64)
    UiLabel Me, "lblMake", "Make", 18, 260, 155, 12
    Set txtMake = UiText(Me, "txtMake", 18, 274, 155, 80)
    UiLabel Me, "lblModel", "Model", 183, 260, 155, 12
    Set txtModel = UiText(Me, "txtModel", 183, 274, 155, 80)
    UiLabel Me, "lblCapacity", "Capacity / revision", 18, 298, 320, 12
    Set txtCapacityRev = UiText(Me, "txtCapacityRev", 18, 312, 320, 80)

    UiLabel Me, "lblDescription", "Description", 360, 70, 320, 12
    Set txtDescription = UiMemo(Me, "txtDescription", 360, 84, 320, 56)
    UiLabel Me, "lblArrival", "Arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD)", 360, 146, 155, 12
    Set txtArrivalDate = UiText(Me, "txtArrivalDate", 360, 160, 155, 10)
    UiLabel Me, "lblExpiry", "Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD)", 525, 146, 155, 12
    Set txtExpiryDate = UiText(Me, "txtExpiryDate", 525, 160, 155, 10)
    UiLabel Me, "lblAssignee", "Give it to this alias ID now (optional)", 360, 184, 320, 12
    Set txtInitialAssignee = UiText(Me, "txtInitialAssignee", 360, 198, 320, 32)
    Set btnSave = UiButton(Me, "btnSave", "Save", 360, 230, 90)
    Set btnClear = UiButton(Me, "btnClear", "Clear", 458, 230, 80)
    Set btnClose = UiButton(Me, "btnClose", "Close", 546, 230, 80)
    btnClose.Cancel = True
    Set lblMessage = UiLabel(Me, "lblMessage", "", 360, 262, 320, 70)
    ClearForm
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    If mBlocked Then
        MsgBox "Only inventory custodians can inward hardware.", vbExclamation, IMS_APP_NAME
        Unload Me
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    txtBarcode.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub txtBarcode_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    If KeyCode = vbKeyReturn Then
        KeyCode = 0
        ApplyBarcode
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub txtModel_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    If KeyCode = vbKeyReturn Or KeyCode = vbKeyTab Then ApplyModel
End Sub

Private Sub btnSave_Click()
    Dim fields As Object
    Set fields = CollectFields()
    If mExisting Then
        If IMS_UpdateAssetMetadata(fields) Then
            IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Details updated for " & fields("Barcode") & ". The holder and status did not change.", False
        Else
            IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
        End If
    Else
        If IMS_SaveNewAsset(fields) Then
            ClearForm
            IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Inward saved for " & fields("Barcode") & ". Scan the next barcode.", False
        Else
            IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
        End If
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnClear_Click()
    ClearForm
End Sub

Private Sub btnClose_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub ApplyBarcode()
    Dim code As String
    Dim asset As Object
    Dim hint As Object
    code = IMS_NormalizeBarcode(txtBarcode.Text)
    txtBarcode.Text = code
    If code = "" Then Exit Sub
    If Not IMS_ValidBarcode(code) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Barcode must be 4 to 64 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo Fail
    Set asset = IMS_GetAsset(code)
    If Not asset Is Nothing Then
        mExisting = True
        FillFromAsset asset
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "This barcode is already on file. Save updates its details only. Use Transfer to change who holds it.", False
        Exit Sub
    End If
    mExisting = False
    txtInitialAssignee.Enabled = True
    Set hint = IMS_SuggestFromBarcode(code)
    FillEmpty hint
    If hint.Exists("Model") Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "New barcode. Empty fields were filled from the latest " & IMS_FamilyPrefix(code) & " asset. Check them, add the PO, and Save.", False
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "New barcode. Choose AMD or Wipro, the type, and the purchase order, then Save.", False
    End If
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Could not read the lab database. " & Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Sub ApplyModel()
    Dim hint As Object
    If mExisting Then Exit Sub
    If Trim$(txtModel.Text) = "" Then Exit Sub
    On Error Resume Next
    Set hint = IMS_SuggestFromModel(txtModel.Text)
    FillEmpty hint
End Sub

Private Sub FillFromAsset(ByVal asset As Object)
    SetOwnership DictStr(asset, "Ownership")
    UiPick cboAssetType, DictStr(asset, "AssetType")
    txtPONumber.Text = DictStr(asset, "PONumber")
    txtManufacturer.Text = DictStr(asset, "Manufacturer")
    txtMfsSerialNo.Text = DictStr(asset, "MfsSerialNo")
    txtMake.Text = DictStr(asset, "Make")
    txtModel.Text = DictStr(asset, "Model")
    txtCapacityRev.Text = DictStr(asset, "Capacity_Rev")
    txtDescription.Text = DictStr(asset, "Description")
    txtArrivalDate.Text = DateOnly(DictStr(asset, "ArrivalDate"))
    txtExpiryDate.Text = DateOnly(DictStr(asset, "ExpiryDate"))
    txtInitialAssignee.Text = DictStr(asset, "CurrentAssigneeID")
    txtInitialAssignee.Enabled = False
End Sub

Private Sub FillEmpty(ByVal hint As Object)
    If hint Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If cboAssetType.ListIndex < 0 And hint.Exists("AssetType") Then UiPick cboAssetType, CStr(hint("AssetType"))
    If txtManufacturer.Text = "" And hint.Exists("Manufacturer") Then txtManufacturer.Text = hint("Manufacturer")
    If txtMake.Text = "" And hint.Exists("Make") Then txtMake.Text = hint("Make")
    If txtModel.Text = "" And hint.Exists("Model") Then txtModel.Text = hint("Model")
    If txtCapacityRev.Text = "" And hint.Exists("Capacity_Rev") Then txtCapacityRev.Text = hint("Capacity_Rev")
End Sub

Private Function CollectFields() As Object
    Dim d As Object
    Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    d.CompareMode = 1
    d("Barcode") = txtBarcode.Text
    If optAMD.Value Then
        d("Ownership") = "AMD-Specific"
    ElseIf optWipro.Value Then
        d("Ownership") = "Wipro-Specific"
    Else
        d("Ownership") = ""
    End If
    d("AssetType") = cboAssetType.Text
    d("PONumber") = txtPONumber.Text
    d("Manufacturer") = txtManufacturer.Text
    d("MfsSerialNo") = txtMfsSerialNo.Text
    d("Make") = txtMake.Text
    d("Model") = txtModel.Text
    d("Capacity_Rev") = txtCapacityRev.Text
    d("Description") = txtDescription.Text
    d("ArrivalDate") = txtArrivalDate.Text
    d("ExpiryDate") = txtExpiryDate.Text
    d("AssigneeID") = txtInitialAssignee.Text
    Set CollectFields = d
End Function

Private Sub SetOwnership(ByVal value As String)
    optAMD.Value = (value = "AMD-Specific")
    optWipro.Value = (value = "Wipro-Specific")
End Sub

Private Sub ClearForm()
    mExisting = False
    txtBarcode.Text = ""
    optAMD.Value = False
    optWipro.Value = False
    cboAssetType.ListIndex = -1
    txtPONumber.Text = ""
    txtManufacturer.Text = ""
    txtMfsSerialNo.Text = ""
    txtMake.Text = ""
    txtModel.Text = ""
    txtCapacityRev.Text = ""
    txtDescription.Text = ""
    txtArrivalDate.Text = ""
    txtExpiryDate.Text = ""
    txtInitialAssignee.Text = ""
    txtInitialAssignee.Enabled = True
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Scan a barcode to begin.", False
    On Error Resume Next
    txtBarcode.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Function DictStr(ByVal d As Object, ByVal key As String) As String
    If d Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If Not d.Exists(key) Then Exit Function
    If IsNull(d(key)) Then Exit Function
    DictStr = Trim$(CStr(d(key)))
End Function

Private Function DateOnly(ByVal value As String) As String
    If Len(value) >= 10 Then DateOnly = Left$(value, 10) Else DateOnly = value
End Function

==============================================================================
frmTransfer.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

' Controls are created in UserForm_Initialize (see modUi).
' No button is the Default button: the scanner sends Enter after each barcode.

Private mLoaded As Boolean
Private mBlocked As Boolean

Private lblMessage As MSForms.Label
Private lblOwnership As MSForms.Label
Private lblType As MSForms.Label
Private lblCurrent As MSForms.Label
Private lblState As MSForms.Label
Private lblHistoryNote As MSForms.Label
Private lstHistory As MSForms.ListBox
Private WithEvents txtBarcode As MSForms.TextBox
Private cboStatus As MSForms.ComboBox
Private txtNewEmpID As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtRemarks As MSForms.TextBox
Private WithEvents btnTransfer As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnClose As MSForms.CommandButton

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    Dim widths As Variant
    If Not IMS_IsCustodianRole(gRole) Then
        mBlocked = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    UiSizeForm Me, "Hardware Lab IMS - Transfer", 790, 400
    UiTitle Me, "lblTitle", "Assign and transfer", 18, 12, 740
    UiHint Me, "lblHint", "Scan the barcode and press Enter. Check who holds it and its history, choose the new status and person, then Record transfer.", 18, 38, 740, 26

    UiLabel Me, "lblBarcode", "Asset barcode *", 18, 70, 320, 12
    Set txtBarcode = UiText(Me, "txtBarcode", 18, 84, 320, 64)
    Set lblOwnership = UiLabel(Me, "lblOwnership", "Ownership:", 18, 110, 320, 14)
    Set lblType = UiLabel(Me, "lblType", "Type / model:", 18, 126, 320, 14)
    Set lblCurrent = UiLabel(Me, "lblCurrent", "Current holder:", 18, 142, 320, 14)
    Set lblState = UiLabel(Me, "lblState", "Status:", 18, 158, 320, 14)
    lblCurrent.Font.Bold = True

    UiLabel Me, "lblStatus", "New status *", 18, 182, 320, 12
    Set cboStatus = UiCombo(Me, "cboStatus", 18, 196, 320)
    IMS_FillCombo cboStatus, IMS_StatusList(), False
    UiPick cboStatus, "Assigned to Engineer"
    UiLabel Me, "lblNewEmp", "Give it to this alias ID (needed for Assigned to Engineer)", 18, 220, 320, 12
    Set txtNewEmpID = UiText(Me, "txtNewEmpID", 18, 234, 320, 32)
    UiLabel Me, "lblRemarks", "Remarks (needed when scrapping or returning)", 18, 258, 320, 12
    Set txtRemarks = UiMemo(Me, "txtRemarks", 18, 272, 320, 36)
    Set btnTransfer = UiButton(Me, "btnTransfer", "Record transfer", 18, 314, 110)
    Set btnClose = UiButton(Me, "btnClose", "Close", 136, 314, 80)
    btnClose.Cancel = True
    Set lblMessage = UiLabel(Me, "lblMessage", "", 18, 342, 320, 30)

    Dim heading As Object
    Set heading = UiLabel(Me, "lblHistory", "History of this asset", 360, 70, 400, 12)
    heading.Font.Bold = True
    Set lblHistoryNote = UiHint(Me, "lblHistoryNote", "Every earlier holder appears here after a scan, newest first.", 360, 84, 400, 12)
    widths = Array(74, 0, 100, 100, 44, 82)
    UiColumnHeads Me, "lblHistCol", Array("When", "", "From", "To", "By", "Remarks"), widths, 360, 100
    Set lstHistory = UiList(Me, "lstHistory", 360, 114, 400, 228, UiWidthsText(widths))
    ClearView
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    If mBlocked Then
        MsgBox "Only inventory custodians can transfer hardware.", vbExclamation, IMS_APP_NAME
        Unload Me
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    txtBarcode.SetFocus
End Sub

Private Sub txtBarcode_KeyDown(ByVal KeyCode As MSForms.ReturnInteger, ByVal Shift As Integer)
    If KeyCode = vbKeyReturn Then
        KeyCode = 0
        LoadAsset
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnTransfer_Click()
    If Not mLoaded Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Scan a barcode first.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IMS_TransferAsset(txtBarcode.Text, txtNewEmpID.Text, txtRemarks.Text, cboStatus.Text) Then
        LoadAsset
        txtNewEmpID.Text = ""
        txtRemarks.Text = ""
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Transfer recorded for " & IMS_NormalizeBarcode(txtBarcode.Text) & ".", False
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnClose_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub LoadAsset()
    Dim asset As Object
    Dim code As String
    code = IMS_NormalizeBarcode(txtBarcode.Text)
    txtBarcode.Text = code
    If code = "" Then Exit Sub
    On Error GoTo Fail
    Set asset = IMS_GetAsset(code)
    If asset Is Nothing Then
        ClearView
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Barcode " & code & " is not in the lab database. Use Inward to add it.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    mLoaded = True
    lblOwnership.Caption = "Ownership: " & DictStr(asset, "Ownership")
    lblType.Caption = "Type / model: " & DictStr(asset, "AssetType") & "  " & DictStr(asset, "Model")
    If DictStr(asset, "CurrentAssigneeID") = "" Then
        lblCurrent.Caption = "Current holder: nobody (in the lab)"
    Else
        lblCurrent.Caption = "Current holder: " & DictStr(asset, "CurrentAssigneeID") & "  " & DictStr(asset, "CurrentAssigneeName")
    End If
    lblState.Caption = "Status: " & DictStr(asset, "Status") & IMS_ExpiryNote(DictStr(asset, "ExpiryDate"))
    LoadHistory code
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Asset loaded. Choose the new status and record the transfer.", False
    Exit Sub
Fail:
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Could not read the lab database. " & Err.Description, True
End Sub

Private Sub LoadHistory(ByVal code As String)
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    lstHistory.Clear
    data = IMS_AssetHistory(code)
    If Not IsArray(data) Then
        If gLastError <> "" Then
            lblHistoryNote.Caption = gLastError
        Else
            lblHistoryNote.Caption = "No earlier movements are recorded for " & code & "."
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If
    For r = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        lstHistory.AddItem CStr(data(r, 1))
        For c = 2 To 6
            lstHistory.List(lstHistory.ListCount - 1, c - 1) = CStr(data(r, c))
        Next c
    Next r
    lblHistoryNote.Caption = CStr(UBound(data, 1)) & " recorded movements for " & code & ", newest first."
End Sub

Private Sub ClearView()
    mLoaded = False
    lblOwnership.Caption = "Ownership:"
    lblType.Caption = "Type / model:"
    lblCurrent.Caption = "Current holder:"
    lblState.Caption = "Status:"
    lstHistory.Clear
    lblHistoryNote.Caption = "Every earlier holder appears here after a scan, newest first."
    IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Scan a barcode to begin.", False
End Sub

Private Function DictStr(ByVal d As Object, ByVal key As String) As String
    If d Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If Not d.Exists(key) Then Exit Function
    If IsNull(d(key)) Then Exit Function
    DictStr = Trim$(CStr(d(key)))
End Function

==============================================================================
frmUserAdmin.frm
VBA editor: File > Import File, and choose this .frm.
==============================================================================
Option Explicit

' Controls are created in UserForm_Initialize (see modUi).

Private mBlocked As Boolean

Private lblMessage As MSForms.Label
Private lblSelected As MSForms.Label
Private WithEvents lstUsers As MSForms.ListBox
Private cboRole As MSForms.ComboBox
Private cboLead As MSForms.ComboBox
Private chkActive As MSForms.CheckBox
Private txtAlias As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtEmail As MSForms.TextBox
Private txtName As MSForms.TextBox
Private WithEvents btnApply As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnReject As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnAllow As MSForms.CommandButton
Private WithEvents btnClose As MSForms.CommandButton

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    Dim widths As Variant
    Dim heading As Object
    If Not IMS_IsSuperRole(gRole) Then
        mBlocked = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    UiSizeForm Me, "Hardware Lab IMS - Accounts", 640, 480
    UiTitle Me, "lblTitle", "Accounts and access requests", 18, 12, 600
    UiHint Me, "lblHint", "Pick a person, choose the real role (and a lead for a User), tick Approve, then Save. Reject closes a request.", 18, 38, 600, 26

    widths = Array(80, 170, 90, 70, 70, 100)
    UiColumnHeads Me, "lblCol", Array("Alias", "Name", "Role", "Status", "Lead", "Requested"), widths, 18, 70
    Set lstUsers = UiList(Me, "lstUsers", 18, 84, 600, 170, UiWidthsText(widths))
    Set lblSelected = UiLabel(Me, "lblSelected", "Select an account in the list.", 18, 260, 600, 14)
    lblSelected.Font.Bold = True

    UiLabel Me, "lblRole", "Real role", 18, 278, 150, 12
    Set cboRole = UiCombo(Me, "cboRole", 18, 292, 150)
    IMS_FillCombo cboRole, IMS_RoleList(), False
    UiLabel Me, "lblLead", "Lead Admin (Users only)", 176, 278, 150, 12
    Set cboLead = UiCombo(Me, "cboLead", 176, 292, 150)
    Set chkActive = UiCheck(Me, "chkActive", "Approve / Active", 334, 292, 120)
    Set btnApply = UiButton(Me, "btnApply", "Save", 460, 290, 76)
    Set btnReject = UiButton(Me, "btnReject", "Reject", 542, 290, 76)

    Set heading = UiLabel(Me, "lblDirHead", "Lab directory", 18, 326, 600, 14)
    heading.Font.Bold = True
    UiHint Me, "lblDirHint", "A person must be on this list before they can request access. Their alias, mail ID and full name must match.", 18, 340, 600, 12
    UiLabel Me, "lblAlias", "Alias ID", 18, 356, 110, 12
    Set txtAlias = UiText(Me, "txtAlias", 18, 370, 110, 32)
    UiLabel Me, "lblEmail", "Mail ID", 134, 356, 190, 12
    Set txtEmail = UiText(Me, "txtEmail", 134, 370, 190, 120)
    UiLabel Me, "lblName", "Full name", 330, 356, 170, 12
    Set txtName = UiText(Me, "txtName", 330, 370, 170, 120)
    Set btnAllow = UiButton(Me, "btnAllow", "Add to directory", 506, 368, 112)

    Set lblMessage = UiLabel(Me, "lblMessage", "", 18, 402, 520, 36)
    Set btnClose = UiButton(Me, "btnClose", "Close", 542, 404, 76)
    btnClose.Cancel = True
    LoadUsers
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Activate()
    If mBlocked Then
        MsgBox "Only a Super Admin can manage accounts.", vbExclamation, IMS_APP_NAME
        Unload Me
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub lstUsers_Click()
    Dim statusText As String
    If lstUsers.ListIndex < 0 Then Exit Sub
    statusText = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 3))
    lblSelected.Caption = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 0)) & "  " & CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 1)) & _
        "  -  " & statusText & ", asked for " & CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 5))
    UiPick cboRole, CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 2))
    chkActive.Value = (statusText = "Active" Or statusText = "Pending")
    UiPick cboLead, CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 4))
    If cboLead.ListIndex < 0 Then cboLead.ListIndex = 0
End Sub

Private Sub btnApply_Click()
    Dim empId As String
    If lstUsers.ListIndex < 0 Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Select an account first.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    empId = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 0))
    If IMS_SetUserRole(empId, cboRole.Text, CBool(chkActive.Value), cboLead.Text) Then
        LoadUsers
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Saved " & empId & ".", False
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnReject_Click()
    Dim empId As String
    If lstUsers.ListIndex < 0 Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Select an account first.", True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    empId = CStr(lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListIndex, 0))
    If IMS_RejectUser(empId) Then
        LoadUsers
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Rejected " & empId & ".", False
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnAllow_Click()
    If IMS_AddAllowedPerson(txtAlias.Text, txtEmail.Text, txtName.Text) Then
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, "Directory updated for " & UCase$(Trim$(txtAlias.Text)) & ". That person can now request access.", False
        txtAlias.Text = ""
        txtEmail.Text = ""
        txtName.Text = ""
    Else
        IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub btnClose_Click()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub LoadUsers()
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim r As Long
    Dim c As Long
    data = IMS_ListUsers()
    lstUsers.Clear
    cboLead.Clear
    cboLead.AddItem ""
    lblSelected.Caption = "Select an account in the list."
    If Not IsArray(data) Then
        If gLastError <> "" Then IMS_Flash lblMessage, gLastError, True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    For r = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        lstUsers.AddItem CStr(data(r, 1))
        For c = 2 To 6
            lstUsers.List(lstUsers.ListCount - 1, c - 1) = CStr(data(r, c))
        Next c
        If CStr(data(r, 3)) = "Lead Admin" And CStr(data(r, 4)) = "Active" Then
            cboLead.AddItem CStr(data(r, 1))
        End If
    Next r
End Sub
